ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher under NS-7; no account flag on the driver.
ruling.reasoning:
This is a driver-cancelled trip recorded as a rider no-show, so the fee can only stand through NS-1, which the trace checks element by element [F4][NS-0]. The location elements pass: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 21:29:45 while 41 m from the pickup, and his closest approach was 3 m at 21:29:20, well inside the 200 m radius the trace applies [F6][F1][NS-1]. The waiting element fails: NS-1(iii) requires more than 3 minutes of continuous presence at the pickup after the arrival confirmation, and the trace measures only 105 s inside the radius after the tap, against a 180 s threshold [F6][NS-1]. The independent timeline figures agree — arrival recorded 21:28:35, cancellation at 21:31:30 two minutes 55 s later, cumulative time within 200 m 2 min 55 s [F5][F2][F4][NS-1]. Pre-tap time near the pickup is expressly not counted, so the 21:28:35–21:29:45 period cannot be added [F2][F6][NS-1].

The driver's post-trip statement that he waited at least 5 minutes is a statement, and the GPS and timeline records contradict it; system records govern the conflict [F12][F2][F6][NS-1]. His chat establishes presence and findability — an arrival ping with a vehicle description at 21:29, then "Cancelling, waited too long" at 21:31 — not that the required wait elapsed; the complete two-message log gives the rider no NS-1(iii) window to arrive [F9][F10][F11][NS-1].

With NS-1(iii) unmet, NS-2 requires the $6.61 cancellation fee to be returned in full [F7][F4][NS-2]. The refund is issued as a Ryde voucher per NS-7, and the fee figure comes straight from the fare record, so no rate arithmetic is needed [F7][NS-7].

No account flag attaches: the trace found no fake arrival confirmation, and the tap was 41 m from the pickup, i.e. genuinely within the radius, so the NS-2 flag condition (arrival confirmed while not at pickup, m_from_pickup_at_tap > 200) is not met [F6][F1][NS-2]. The driver's profile (976 days, 1216 trips, 0 upheld disputes) is not used to decide the case and is not used for a flag [F17][NS-2].

Safety screen: I read both chat messages, the driver's statement and the rider's complaint. They concern arrival, waiting and cancellation; nothing threatens, intimidates, harasses or alleges dangerous driving [F9][F10][F12][SAFE-1]. No escalation under SAFE-2 applies either.

Evidence status is sufficient: the trace confirms the GPS trace covers the wait with no hole from the arrival confirmation to the cancellation, and every element needed (who cancelled, tap distance, post-tap duration, fee charged) is settled by records [F2][F6][F4][F7][NS-1].

rejected_claims.reason: D2 argues the $6.61 is chargeable because NS-0/NS-1 contemplate a fee for a driver-cancelled no-show, but the fee only stands if NS-1's conditions hold; the trace shows NS-1(iii) is unmet (105 s post-tap vs 180 s threshold) and the timeline shows only 2 min 55 s, so NS-2 reverses the charge [F6][F2][F4][NS-1][NS-2].

D3 relies on the driver's post-trip statement of a 5-minute wait, but a statement loses to the GPS/timeline records, which show 1 min 45 s inside 200 m after the tap and 2 min 55 s cumulative before cancellation; being findable is not waiting the required time [F12][F2][F6][NS-1].

D4 argues the complete timestamped chat helps the driver; the log in fact shows only an arrival ping at 21:29 and a cancellation notice at 21:31, leaving no NS-1(iii) window after the driver's own arrival confirmation [F11][F9][F10][NS-1].

D6 asks that no account flag attach on the strength of the driver's 1216 trips and 0 upheld disputes; the no-flag outcome follows from the trace (arrival confirmation valid, no abuse of the button), not from profile facts, which never decide a case [F17][F6][NS-2].

C7 invokes RD-4 traffic justification, which concerns route deviation and the tolls/ERP branch of a detour refund; this is a no-show cancellation case and no off-route segment exists, so the traffic and weather facts do not bear on the fee [F13][F14][F15][NS-1][NS-2].
